name: Brand of Redemption
body:
School transmutation [curse]; Level cleric 6, inquisitor 4, oracle 6, paladin 4, warpriest

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target evil creature touched
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell etches a symbol of the sun on the target’s body and soul, dealing 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 15d6). If a target succeeds at a Will save, it takes half of this damage and the brand does not take hold.

A creature branded by this spell takes a -8 penalty on Bluff and Stealth checks. Every time a branded creature knowingly commits an evil act, the brand burns, dealing 5d6 points of damage and sickening it for 1 hour (no save). A brand of redemption cannot be hidden, as it emits a strong, penetrating, sun-like glow even when scraped off or concealed. Half the damage dealt by this spell is fire damage, and the other half results directly from divine power and is therefore not subject to being reduced by resistance to fire-based attacks. This spell cannot reduce the target’s hit points to less than -1 and a creature that falls to -1 hit points by this spell’s damage is automatically stabilized.

A remove curse spell ends a brand of redemption spell only if its caster level is at least two higher than your caster level. Break enchantment does not end a brand of redemption, but limited wish, miracle, and wish do. The brand permanently vanishes on its own if the creature ever permanently shifts to Good alignment.
